articles.summary: Under Armour and Baseball Factory will host the UA Next All-America Game at Oriole Park at Camden Yards for the second consecutive year, welcoming many of the nation’s top high school baseball players to Baltimore on Sunday, August 30. The premier showcase event celebrates the next generation of the game, bringing together elite athletes from across the country for a weekend of competition, development and unforgettable experiences.
articles.title: UA Next All-America Game Returns to Camden Yards for Second Straight Year

articles.summary: Under Armour today announced the signing of Jade Iginla, a rising force in women's hockey and one of the newest faces of the Professional Women's Hockey League (PWHL). The multi-year partnership will see her represent the brand on and off the ice.
articles.title: Under Armour Signs Rising Canadian Hockey Star Jade Iginla

articles.summary: Under Armour has introduced a new brand platform that brings to life the commitment stories and moments of athletes who keep showing up for the sports they love. The platform reflects Under Armour’s belief that what draws people back to the track, the court, the gym and the field is not only the result, the win or the applause, but the strength, growth, freedom, joy and fulfillment discovered when they truly commit to something they believe in.
articles.title: Under Armour Launches New Brand Platform Centered on Commit, Spotlighting the Growth and Rewards Found in Sport

articles.summary: Meridian Legging is back with its most refined update yet. An upgraded fabric delivers the same buttery feel, better for you and for the planet. A no-front-seam construction creates a cleaner silhouette and more secure, body-hugging fit. A SmoothSculpt™ waistband stays comfortably in place, delivering support without digging in or rolling down.
articles.title: Your Softest Legging Just Got Better: UA Meridian

articles.summary: The new UA Bouncy Tee for women combines a clean, flattering fit with the performance technology Under Armour is known for. Bounces back after wearing it all weekend, moisture-wicking, and pit stain resistance.
articles.title: How Rachael Kirkconnell Is Styling The Bouncy Tee This Fall

articles.summary: The Under Armour Fox 3 was built to meet the lightning-quick first step, elite end-to-end speed and the ability to stop on a dime, turning full-speed attacks into controlled finishes, kickouts and game-changing plays of De'Aaron Fox. A lightweight performance Basketball shoe. Tailored to enhance his style of play: explosive speed with the control to brake, plant and attack again. That balance between speed and control is the foundation of this sneaker, and every element is designed to support the dynamic nature of his game.
articles.title: Under Armour Basketball Introduces the Fox 3

articles.summary: Under Armour announces the appointment of multi-platinum, Grammy-nominated artist Gunna as its Global Brand Ambassador and Creative Director of P-Star, a multi-dimensional creative platform conceived under Gunna’s creative direction spanning apparel, footwear, community initiatives and cultural storytelling.
articles.title: Under Armour Names Gunna Global Brand Ambassador and Creative Director of P-Star

articles.summary: The Baltimore Ravens and Under Armour announced Tuesday a 10-year extension of their longstanding partnership, continuing to bring together two iconic Baltimore-based brands. With a shared commitment to the local community, the partnership will bring added value to Ravens fans with a new exclusive Ravens x Under Armour product collection, elevated hospitality experiences at M&T Bank Stadium and continued investments in youth football initiatives and the Under Armour Performance Center.
articles.title: Under Armour and Baltimore Ravens Announce 10-year Partnership Extension

articles.summary: Building on the legacy of its control-focused boot range, Under Armour has unveiled the all-new Magnetico Elite 6. Engineered for players who dictate the tempo rather than react to it, the latest iteration of the Magnetico delivers enhanced touch, improved comfort and total control from the first whistle to the last.
articles.title: Under Armour Launches its Latest Football Boot Innovation: The Magnetico Elite 6
